verdict.rationale: Cooley's emerging companies page documents IPO experience for venture-backed companies, claiming it has been the "#1 law firm representing VC-backed companies going public for the last 20 years." Its pages also mention AI-assisted S-1 drafting. M&A evidence is only indirect: the privacy team cites 400+ due diligence reviews for M&A and investment transactions. Missing for 10: a dedicated M&A practice page or documented M&A deal volume for venture-backed companies, a dedicated capital-markets/IPO practice page, and independent corroboration of exit experience.
